decisions.reason: Having already been retained once, this camera now carries additional sunk cost and managerial self-justification, and as a publicly presented product close to the core offer it remains unlikely to be withdrawn.
This modular camera line is strongly tied to the firm's announced move toward compact and flexible sensors, and the visible commitment across several models makes continuation especially likely.

Although public commitment is weaker because the LiDAR sensor was only mentioned on the website, it still fits the firm's miniaturization trajectory and accumulated development effort argues for persistence.

The radiation-hard camera line is newly and visibly launched on its own page, sits squarely in the firm's trusted space-imaging niche, and multiple models increase commitment to keep it on the market.

This asteroid navigation and imaging camera is strategically related to the core business, but its more specialized niche and lower website prominence make it somewhat more droppable than the firm's more visibly backed camera lines.
